4013217426251210843fe256885b152d81c8ee81: Pany is a low-key resort on a modest scale — 7 km of runs for an intimate skiing experience, far from the bustle of the big resorts. This is where people come for calm, authenticity and no queues at the lifts. Pany's family reputation is well deserved: dedicated beginner areas, well-groomed green runs and a friendly atmosphere at the foot of the lifts. It is one of the most reassuring resorts in the Northern Alps for laying the foundations of skiing with children. Pany's modest altitude — starting at 1330 m, topping out at 1565 m — makes it sensitive to climate variations. January and February remain the safest months for optimal snow cover. Outside that window, checking the snow reports before you leave is strongly advised. The day lift pass at 34€ remains reasonable for the quality of the ski area on offer. Counting accommodation, skiing and meals, Pany is for those who want a lovely week without the final bill knocking them off their chair. In short: Pany doesn't compete with the giants of skiing, and doesn't pretend to. It is an honest, often underrated destination that deserves to be (re)discovered.
